items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-21
items.q: The same core construction that Don Starr uses on a previous record that I played here.

ctx.x: All night long. All night long. All night long. All night long. All night long. All night long. All night long. All night long.

All night long. All night long. All night long. All night long. All night long. The same core construction that Don Starr uses on a previous record that I played here. On these big fat skinny poppers. Was that it? Let's see.
Let me see the right now. Let me see the other side. Sweet old poppers, huh? Let me try. Sweet old poppers. It stops.
